test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_statistics_low_cardinality_string_src( c1 UInt64, c2 String, c3 LowCardinality(String), c4 FixedString(16), c5 LowCardinality(FixedString(16))) ENGINE = Memory;
CREATE TABLE t_statistics_string_regular_none( c1 UInt64, c2 String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;
CREATE TABLE t_statistics_string_low_cardinality_none( c1 UInt64, c2 LowCardinality(String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;
CREATE TABLE t_statistics_fixed_string_regular_none( c1 UInt64, c2 FixedString(16)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;

CREATE TABLE t_statistics_fixed_string_low_cardinality_none( c1 UInt64, c2 LowCardinality(FixedString(16))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;

CREATE TABLE t_statistics_string_regular_{statistic}( c1 UInt64, c2 String STATISTICS({statistic})) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;

CREATE TABLE t_statistics_string_low_cardinality_{statistic}( c1 UInt64, c2 LowCardinality(String) STATISTICS({statistic})) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;

CREATE TABLE t_statistics_fixed_string_regular_{statistic}( c1 UInt64, c2 FixedString(16) STATISTICS({statistic})) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;

CREATE TABLE t_statistics_fixed_string_low_cardinality_{statistic}( c1 UInt64, c2 LowCardinality(FixedString(16)) STATISTICS({statistic})) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c1 SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', materialize_statistics_on_merge = 0;
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_statistics_low_cardinality_string_src SELECT number, toString(number % 100000), toString(number % 100000), toFixedString(leftPad(toString(number % 100000), 16, '0'), 16), toFixedString(leftPad(toString(number % 100000), 16, '0'), 16) FROM numbers(1000000)
test.query: INSERT INTO t_statistics_string_regular_none SELECT c1, c2 FROM t_statistics_low_cardinality_string_src SETTINGS materialize_statistics_on_insert = 1
INSERT INTO t_statistics_string_low_cardinality_none SELECT c1, c3 FROM t_statistics_low_cardinality_string_src SETTINGS materialize_statistics_on_insert = 1
INSERT INTO t_statistics_fixed_string_regular_none SELECT c1, c4 FROM t_statistics_low_cardinality_string_src SETTINGS materialize_statistics_on_insert = 1
INSERT INTO t_statistics_fixed_string_low_cardinality_none SELECT c1, c5 FROM t_statistics_low_cardinality_string_src SETTINGS materialize_statistics_on_insert = 1
